title: Transducer Gain Testbench
text: Measures transducer gain of system; {Use Internal Configuration block} uses testbench internal configuration block, {Simulate noise (both stimulus and DUT internal)} enables noise modeling in stimulus signal, {Input power amplitude (dBm)} sets the input power to DUT, {Input frequency (Hz)} sets the carrier frequency, {Output frequency (Hz)} sets the output frequency, {Baseband bandwidth (Hz)} sets the baseband bandwidth of input, {Source resistance (Ohm)} sets the source resistance to measure DUT, {Load resistance (Ohm)} sets the load resistance to measure DUT, {Show Response spectrum} sets the view response spectrum using a spectrum scope during and {Ground and hide negative terminals} sets the internally ground and hide RF circuit. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Use Internal Configuration block
params.values: Use testbench internal configuration block on (default) | off

params.name: Simulate noise (both stimulus and DUT internal)
params.values: Enable noise modeling in stimulus signal on (default) | off

params.name: Baseband bandwidth (Hz)
params.values: Baseband bandwidth of input signal 10e6 (default) | scalar

params.name: Source resistance (Ohm)
params.values: Source resistance to measure DUT 50 (default) | positive finite scalar

params.name: Load resistance (Ohm)
params.values: Load resistance to measure DUT 50 (default) | positive finite scalar

params.name: Show Response spectrum
params.values: View response spectrum using a spectrum scope during simulation on (default) | off

params.name: Ground and hide negative terminals
params.values: Internally ground and hide RF circuit terminals on (default) | off
